mechanism_narrative: A higher current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases the cost of capital for corporations and reduces the present value of future equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 0.2%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 10.0% over a 1-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 10.0% in the last month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and business investment, which together drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are rising, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates capacity utilization approaching limits, leading to inflationary pressures and potential central bank tightening, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC for INDPRO in late-cycle regimes over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher current level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong residential construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST is above its 3-month average, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% annually signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% annually, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS is rising and UNRATE is falling, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS is rising, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS in monetary tightening cycles over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
